verdict: ROAS dropped sharply this week; purchases are clustering, not flowing steadily.
narrative: Over the last 28 days your Meta ads delivered a 3.6x return on ad spend, but the most recent 7 days tell a harder story — return on ad spend fell 60% week-over-week while daily spend held nearly flat at ~$54/day, meaning the same budget is producing far fewer purchases. The pattern underneath is fragile: purchases are arriving in isolated bursts rather than a consistent daily flow, with six near-zero conversion days recorded in the last stretch despite continued spend. The top campaign is likely reaching the same audience too frequently, compressing its effectiveness. We're moving to refresh the ad creative and broaden the audience approach this week to break that cycle, and the funnel test and UTM tracking are due to close by August 31st, which will give us cleaner conversion visibility going forward.
